narrative.overview: The owner chose a black-and-silver replacement for the warm-paper portfolio. The software leads: restrained chrome, large condensed lettering, and real application imagery with room to breathe.
keyCharacteristics: A continuous black ground with silver text.
One focal application rather than equal promotional tiles.
Real screenshots and clearly identified app artwork.

rules.name: The Unfiltered Work Rule
rules.body: Preserve the original colors and proportions of application images.

dos: Do preserve app identities and real image proportions.
Do label official artwork separately from interface screenshots.
Do keep all introductory content and downloads accessible without JavaScript.
donts: Don't invent product screens, usage data, biography details, or feature claims.
Don't revive the superseded cream-and-serif identity for new sections.
Don't turn the exhibition into glowing panels or a decorative dashboard.
